description: Client-side script for rendering multiple charts (bar and doughnut) based on invoice data fetched via AJAX from '/invoice/graph/'. It initializes data arrays, makes AJAX GET requests, and creates Chart.js charts with the received data.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Callback function processing successful AJAX response, updating chart data and rendering charts.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Callback function handling AJAX errors, logging errors to console.
